text: dsh-chat-shell 是供 DSH 桌面端使用的聊天网页切换插件。它在窗口中提供 Chat 与 Harness 开关及站点选择器，通过桌面浏览器桥接加载 DeepSeek、豆包或 ChatGPT，也可添加其他 HTTP(S) 网站。切换时保留已挂载网页，插件把模式、站点和站点列表保存在本地。适合希望在 Harness 窗口内直接使用聊天网页并快速切回工作界面的用户。使用时需要自行登录所选网站；代码没有要求额外 API Key。

dsh-chat-shell adds Chat and Harness controls to DSH desktop. Pick DeepSeek, Doubao, ChatGPT, or another HTTP(S) site to open in the embedded browser. Sites stay mounted while switching, and the mode and site list are saved locally. Sign in to your chosen site; no extra API key is required.
想在 DSH 桌面窗口里打开 DeepSeek、豆包或 ChatGPT。
我希望添加一个聊天网站，并在 Harness 和网页之间快速切换。
I want to switch between my Harness workspace and an embedded AI chat site.
dsh-chat-shell 的功能「切换聊天与 Harness」：标题栏提供 Chat 与 Harness 两个选项，点击标签或拖动滑块即可切换窗口内容；已加载的网站保持挂载。
dsh-chat-shell 的功能「选择或添加网站」：通过站点按钮打开菜单，可选择 DeepSeek、豆包、ChatGPT，或输入一个 HTTP(S) 地址添加网站；新站点以主机名作为标签并保存。
dsh-chat-shell 使用前须知：选中的聊天网页在内嵌浏览器中加载；向该网页提交的对话内容由对应站点接收，例如 DeepSeek、豆包或 ChatGPT。

dsh-chat-shell README · dsh-chat-shell：> A **Chat / Harness** switch for DeepSeek Harness:
> embed DeepSeek, Doubao or ChatGPT in the whole window, and get back to Harness
> with one click — without losing your conversation, your scroll position or a
> reply that is still streaming.

dsh-chat-shell README · dsh-chat-shell：

---

dsh-chat-shell README · What it does：DeepSeek Harness is one window with one interface. This plugin adds a second one:
a glass segmented switch in the title bar, with the sites you use beside it.

```
Harness                            Chat
┌────────────────────────────┐    ┌────────────────────────────┐
│  应用  编辑   Chat│Harness  │    │  应用  编辑  ⬤▾  Chat│Harness│
├────────────────────────────┤    ├────────────────────────────┤

Both sides stay alive. Switching is a fade, not a page load:

dsh-chat-shell README · Features：| | |
|---|---|
| **Segmented switch** | `Chat \| Harness`, centred in the title bar. Click either label, or drag the glass thumb and drop it where you want it. |
| **Site button** | Real brand mark + a caret, left of the switch. Open it to pick a site, or to add one of your own. |
| **Three presets** | DeepSeek, Doubao (豆包), ChatGPT — each in its own browser session. |
| **Add any website** | Paste a URL; the label is derived from the hostname. Custom sites are stored next to the presets. |
| **Instant switching** | Sites are mounted once and toggled with CSS, never torn down on a switch. |
| **Remembers everything** | Last mode, last site and your site list survive a reload. |
| **Follows the theme** | Light and dark are detected from the live page and re-applied whenever the app theme changes. |
| **Fails soft** | On a browser-hosted DSH (no desktop bridge) the switch simply hides itself instead of breaking the page. |

dsh-chat-shell README · Requirements：* **DeepSeek Harness desktop** 0.2.x — the embedded browser is provided by the
  Electron shell and does not exist in `dsh web`.
* Windows (the desktop build this was developed and tested against).

dsh-chat-shell README · With the plugin market / CLI：```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-chat-shell
```

dsh-chat-shell README · Manually (local folder)：1. Copy this folder into the profile's `node_modules`:

```
   %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-chat-shell
   ```

2. Add the plugin to the profile patch, `…\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: chat-shell
         name: dsh-chat-shell
   ```

3. Save. The desktop app hot-reloads the plugin graph, so the switch appears
   without restarting; if it does not, restart the app once.

dsh-chat-shell README · Use：* **Switch** — click `Chat` or `Harness`, or drag the thumb.
* **Pick a site** — click the round button left of the switch.
* **Add a site** — open the picker, choose `＋ 添加 AI 网页`, paste a URL, `Enter`.
* **Go back to Harness** — one click; nothing else changes.

The plugin keeps exactly one preference key in `localStorage`:

dsh-chat-shell README · Use：```jsonc
// dsh-chat-shell:state
{
  "mode": "chat",                                  // "chat" | "harness"
  "active": "deepseek",                            // id of the selected site

To reset everything, run `localStorage.removeItem("dsh-chat-shell:state")` in the
app's devtools and reload.

dsh-chat-shell README · Staying logged in (optional)：Out of the box the embedded browsers use an **in-memory** session partition, so
every restart of the app logs you out again. That is a property of the shell, not
of this plugin.

`scripts/patch-persistent-login.mjs` fixes it with a **one-line change** to the
shell, made on a copy, with the original archive kept for rollback:

```
- partition = `dsh-sidebar-browser-${randomUUID()}`;
+ partition = `persist:dsh-sidebar-browser-${createHash("sha1").update(workspace)…}`;
```

dsh-chat-shell README · Staying logged in (optional)：```bash
node scripts/patch-persistent-login.mjs status     # is the shell patched?
node scripts/patch-persistent-login.mjs build      # extract + patch (no swap)
node scripts/patch-persistent-login.mjs apply      # prepare the swap…

dsh-chat-shell README · …then double-click apply-patch.cmd and quit DSH (应用 → 退出)：```

Read **[docs/persistent-login.md](docs/persistent-login.md)** before running it:
it edits the installed application, it is Windows-only, and a DSH update
overwrites it (re-run `build` + `apply` afterwards). The plugin works without it.
section: …then double-click apply-patch.cmd and quit DSH (应用 → 退出)

dsh-chat-shell README · Limits worth knowing：* **Desktop only.** The switch needs the desktop bridge `dshDesktop.browser`,
  which the browser-hosted DSH does not expose. The plugin detects this and stays
  out of the way.
* **The bridge is not a documented API.** It is a stable-looking internal
  contract of the 0.2.x shell; a future DSH release may rename it. If that
  happens the switch hides itself rather than throwing.
* **The embedded browser is locked down by the shell** — no downloads, no
  permission prompts, no nested webviews, no HTTP authentication dialogs. That is
  deliberate and this plugin does not try to relax it.
* **Some sites may notice the embedded browser.** DeepSeek, Doubao and ChatGPT
  all render and accept input today; a site that blocks automation will show its
  own notice, which no plugin-side workaround should try to defeat.
* **One window per site is not on the roadmap** — each site is a single tab.

dsh-chat-shell README · Uninstall：1. Remove the `chat-shell` entry from `cordis.patch.yml` (or run
   `dsh plugin remove dsh-chat-shell`).
2. Delete `…\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-chat-shell`.
3. If you applied the optional shell patch, run
   `node scripts/patch-persistent-login.mjs restore` first — otherwise the
   patched shell keeps loading, which is harmless but no longer updated by the
   plugin's uninstall.

dsh-chat-shell README · How it works：* The package is a **client plugin**: `lib/client.js` is a plain ES module wrapped
  in `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`, and `lib/index.js` exists
  only because the loader mounts every package on both sides.
* On mount it registers nothing into the slot tree. Instead it paints three
  elements into `document.body` — a full-screen panel, the site button and the
  switch — and positions them over the app shell (`z-index` above the layout,
  `-webkit-app-region: no-drag` so the title bar stays clickable).
* Each site becomes a `<webview>` created exactly the way the built-in sidebar
  browser creates it:

dsh-chat-shell README · How it works：The shell only attaches a webview whose `src` is `about:blank#<lease>` and
  overwrites the web preferences itself, so a wrong element is rejected rather
  than silently running with different privileges.
* Colours are read from the live page (`getComputedStyle`), turned into a small
  palette of CSS custom properties, and recomputed when the app theme changes
  (`MutationObserver` on `<html>`/`<body>` + `prefers-color-scheme`).
* No build step, no dependencies, no network requests of its own.
dsh-chat-shell README · How it works：</details>

dsh-chat-shell README · Development：The package is plain JavaScript, aimed at the browser. There is nothing to
compile:

```bash
node --check lib/client.js                    # syntax only
node scripts/patch-persistent-login.mjs status
```

To iterate: edit `lib/client.js` in your profile's `node_modules`, save, and the
desktop app reloads the plugin graph. The file is UTF-8 and contains Chinese
labels inline — edit it with a UTF-8 aware editor (PowerShell `Set-Content`
will corrupt it).

dsh-chat-shell README · 它做什么：DeepSeek Harness 是一个窗口、一套界面。这个插件在标题栏正中加了一个玻璃质感的
分段开关，旁边是站点按钮：

```
Harness                            Chat
┌────────────────────────────┐    ┌────────────────────────────┐
│  应用  编辑   Chat│Harness  │    │  应用  编辑  ⬤▾  Chat│Harness│
├────────────────────────────┤    ├────────────────────────────┤

两边常驻。切换是一次淡入淡出，不是一次页面加载：

* Harness 里的会话、滚动位置、正在跑的工具调用都不受影响；
* 每个 AI 网页只挂载一次，你切回 Harness 的时候，它那边的回答还在继续生成；
* 每个站点各自一个浏览器会话，三个账号的登录态互不覆盖。

dsh-chat-shell README · 功能：| | |
|---|---|
| **分段开关** | 标题栏正中的 `Chat \| Harness`。点标签切换，或者按住玻璃滑块拖到另一边松手。 |
| **站点按钮** | 真实品牌图标 + 小箭头，贴在开关左侧。点开选站点，或添加自己的站点。 |
| **三个预置站点** | DeepSeek、豆包、ChatGPT，各自独立的浏览器会话。 |
| **可添加任意网站** | 粘贴 URL 即可，名字取域名；自定义站点与预置站点并存。 |
| **秒切** | 站点只挂载一次，切换靠 CSS 显隐，不会销毁重建。 |
| **记住状态** | 上次的模式、上次的站点、站点列表，重载后都在。 |
| **跟随主题** | 从当前页面实时取色，App 换主题时自动重算，深色浅色都对。 |
| **优雅降级** | 浏览器版 DSH 没有桌面桥时，开关自己隐藏，不影响页面。 |

dsh-chat-shell README · 环境要求：* **DeepSeek Harness 桌面版** 0.2.x —— 内嵌浏览器由 Electron 外壳提供，`dsh web` 里没有。
* Windows（本插件的开发与测试平台）。

dsh-chat-shell README · 通过插件市场 / CLI：```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-chat-shell
```

dsh-chat-shell README · 手动（本地目录）：1. 把本目录复制到 profile 的 `node_modules` 里：

```
   %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-chat-shell
   ```

2. 在 `…\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml` 里追加：

```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: chat-shell
         name: dsh-chat-shell
   ```

3. 保存。桌面端会热重载插件图，开关直接出现；若没出现，重启一次应用。

dsh-chat-shell README · 使用：* **切换** —— 点 `Chat` 或 `Harness`，或者拖动滑块。
* **换站点** —— 点开关左边那颗圆按钮。
* **添加站点** —— 打开菜单 → `＋ 添加 AI 网页` → 粘贴 URL → 回车。
* **回到 Harness** —— 一次点击，别的一切照旧。

插件只写一个本地偏好键：

```jsonc
// dsh-chat-shell:state
{
  "mode": "chat",                                  // "chat" | "harness"
  "active": "deepseek",                            // 当前站点的 id

想重置，在应用开发者工具里执行 `localStorage.removeItem("dsh-chat-shell:state")`
后重载即可。

dsh-chat-shell README · 保持登录状态（可选）：默认情况下内嵌浏览器使用的是**内存**会话分区，所以每次重启应用都要重新登录 ——
这是外壳的行为，不是插件的行为。

`scripts/patch-persistent-login.mjs` 用**一行改动**把它修好：改动打在解包出来的副本
上，原压缩包原样保留，随时可回滚。

```
- partition = `dsh-sidebar-browser-${randomUUID()}`;
+ partition = `persist:dsh-sidebar-browser-${createHash("sha1").update(workspace)…}`;
```

```bash
node scripts/patch-persistent-login.mjs status     # 外壳是否已打补丁
node scripts/patch-persistent-login.mjs build      # 解包 + 打补丁（不换文件）
node scripts/patch-persistent-login.mjs apply      # 准备换文件…

dsh-chat-shell README · …然后双击 apply-patch.cmd，并在应用里「应用 → 退出」：```

动手之前请先读 **[docs/persistent-login.md](docs/persistent-login.md)**：它会修改已安装
的应用、只支持 Windows，而且 DSH 升级会覆盖它（升级后重跑 `build` + `apply`）。
不打这个补丁，插件本身照常工作，只是重启后要重新登录。

dsh-chat-shell README · 已知限制：* **仅桌面版。** 开关依赖桌面桥 `dshDesktop.browser`，浏览器版 DSH 不提供；插件会
  检测到这一点并自动隐藏。
* **这个桥不是公开 API。** 它是 0.2.x 外壳里一个看起来稳定的内部契约，将来可能改名。
  真发生了，开关会隐藏自己，而不是把页面搞崩。
* **内嵌浏览器由外壳上锁** —— 不下载、不弹权限、不允许嵌套 webview、不弹 HTTP 认证框。
  这是刻意的，本插件不会去放松它。
* **站点可能识别内嵌浏览器。** DeepSeek、豆包、ChatGPT 目前都能正常渲染与输入；如果
  某个站点弹出自动化提示，那是它自己的策略，插件不应绕过。
* **不做多开分屏** —— 每个站点一个标签页。

dsh-chat-shell README · 卸载：1. 从 `cordis.patch.yml` 里删掉 `chat-shell` 那条（或 `dsh plugin remove dsh-chat-shell`）。
2. 删除 `…\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-chat-shell`。
3. 如果打过可选的壳补丁，先执行 `node scripts/patch-persistent-login.mjs restore`。

dsh-chat-shell README · 实现要点：<details>
<summary>60 秒版本</summary>

* 这是一个**客户端插件**：`lib/client.js` 是被 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`
  包起来的普通 ES 模块；`lib/index.js` 之所以存在，是因为加载器要求每个包在 host 侧
  也有一个 `apply`。
* 挂载时它不往 slot 树里注册任何东西，而是往 `document.body` 里画三个元素 —— 全屏面板、
  站点按钮、开关 —— 用 `z-index` 盖在外壳之上，并用 `-webkit-app-region: no-drag`
  保证标题栏仍然可点。
* 每个站点是一个 `<webview>`，创建方式与内置侧栏浏览器完全一致：
dsh-chat-shell README · 实现要点：</details>

dsh-chat-shell README · 开发：纯 JavaScript，面向浏览器，没有编译环节：

```bash
node --check lib/client.js                    # 只做语法检查
node scripts/patch-persistent-login.mjs status
```

调试方式：直接改 profile `node_modules` 里的 `lib/client.js`，保存后桌面端会热重载插件图。
文件是 UTF-8 且内联中文标签 —— 请用能正确处理 UTF-8 的编辑器（PowerShell 的
`Set-Content` 会把它写坏）。
